notes: Detailed player-facing mechanics for KOTOR Campaign Guide Jedi Battlemaster, Jedi Shadow, and Jedi Watchman talents.

rules.name: Defensive Circle
rules.description: Turn Battle Meditation into a coordinated defense and strengthen lightsaber reactions near allied Jedi.

mechanics.use: Swift action while Battle Meditation is active.
mechanics.target: You and allies currently affected by your Battle Meditation.
mechanics.effect: Affected characters gain +2 insight to Reflex Defense for as long as the meditation affects them. You also gain +1 on Use the Force checks for Block and Deflect per adjacent ally wielding a lightsaber.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 39

rules.name: Force Revive
rules.description: Use Battle Meditation to let a fallen ally trigger a second wind immediately.

mechanics.trigger: An ally affected by your Battle Meditation is reduced to 0 hit points.
mechanics.effect: The ally immediately uses second wind as a reaction.
mechanics.special: The ally falls unconscious before second wind resolves, but can recover from the restored hit points normally.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 39

rules.name: Jedi Battle Commander
rules.description: Improve the offensive coordination granted by Battle Meditation.

mechanics.effect: Your Battle Meditation grants +2 insight on attack rolls instead of +1.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 39

rules.name: Slashing Charge
rules.description: Block attacks and make Riposte counterattacks while charging without escalating Block penalties.

mechanics.use: Declare during a charge before your first Riposte; once per encounter.
mechanics.effect: During that charge, Block attempts do not suffer the cumulative Use the Force penalty from earlier Block attempts made during the charge. Apply the charge attack bonus to every Riposte attack made during it.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 39

rules.name: Mobile Attack (Lightsabers)
rules.description: Reposition freely after completing a two-lightsaber full attack.

mechanics.use: Free action immediately after the qualifying full attack.
mechanics.trigger: Complete a full attack using two lightsabers or both ends of a double-bladed lightsaber.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 39

rules.name: Dark Deception
rules.description: Mask your true alignment behind apparent anger and hatred.

mechanics.trigger: Another character attempts to sense you through the Force.
mechanics.effect: You may choose to appear as though your Dark Side Score equals your Wisdom score.
mechanics.special: Deception becomes a class skill for you.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 39

rules.name: Improved Sentinel Strike
rules.description: Increase the bonus-damage die from Sentinel Strike.

mechanics.effect: Each bonus-damage die granted by Sentinel Strike becomes d8 instead of d6.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 39

rules.name: Improved Sentinel's Gambit
rules.description: Use Sentinel's Gambit several additional times each encounter.

mechanics.effect: Gain additional uses of Sentinel's Gambit per encounter equal to half your Jedi Knight class level, minimum 1.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 39

rules.name: Rebuke the Dark
rules.description: Rebuke Force powers carrying the dark-side descriptor more reliably.

mechanics.trigger: Use Rebuke against a Force power with the dark-side descriptor.
mechanics.effect: Roll the Rebuke Use the Force check twice and keep the better result.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 39

rules.name: Taint of the Dark Side
rules.description: Learn one dark-side Force power and use it sparingly without increasing your Dark Side Score.

mechanics.effect: Add one Force power with the dark-side descriptor to your Force suite. Once per encounter, you may use that power without increasing your Dark Side Score.
mechanics.special: Other uses of that power follow the normal Dark Side Score rules.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 39

rules.name: Force Warning
rules.description: Warn nearby allies of danger, improving initiative and preventing some allies from being surprised.

mechanics.effect: Each target may reroll Initiative but must keep the second result. If you are not surprised, choose surprised allies up to your Wisdom modifier, minimum 1; those allies are no longer surprised and may act in the surprise round.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 40

rules.name: Improved Quick Draw (Lightsabers)
rules.description: Draw, ignite, and attack with a lightsaber during a surprise round, even when surprised.

mechanics.trigger: A surprise round begins while a lightsaber is in your hand or on your belt.
mechanics.effect: Draw, ignite, and make one attack even if surprised. If not surprised, you may instead take any normal single action.
mechanics.special: Once per turn on your turn, you may draw and ignite a lightsaber as a free action.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 40

rules.name: Sheltering Stance
rules.description: Protect an adjacent ally with Block or Deflect without spending a Force Point.

mechanics.trigger: An attack targets an adjacent ally and is eligible for your Block or Deflect talent.
mechanics.effect: You may use Block or Deflect to protect that ally without paying the normal Force Point cost for defending another character.
mechanics.special: All other Block or Deflect requirements and cumulative penalties apply.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 40

rules.name: Vigilance
rules.description: Maintain a protective stance that reinforces one adjacent ally's Reflex Defense.

mechanics.use: Swift action to designate or change the target.
mechanics.effect: Target gains +1 deflection to Reflex Defense.
mechanics.duration: While you remain adjacent to that ally or until you designate another.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 40

rules.name: Watchman's Advance
rules.description: Grant your entire side extra movement during a surprise round.

mechanics.trigger: You act during a surprise round.
mechanics.effect: Each target may take one extra move action during that surprise round.
mechanics.special: A character can gain only one extra move action this way regardless of how many allied Jedi possess this talent.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 40
